def factor_vwap_sma_smooth_blend(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    window_base = 20
    window_short = 10
    # Compression score (same as parent)
    true_range = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_mean = true_range.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    range_std = true_range.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).std(ddof=1)
    range_zscore = (true_range - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio_mean = vol_ratio.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    vol_ratio_std = vol_ratio.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).std(ddof=1)
    vol_ratio_zscore = (vol_ratio - vol_ratio_mean) / vol_ratio_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    compression = -range_zscore - vol_ratio_zscore
    # Short-window VWAP-SMA divergence
    vp_short = df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]
    vwap_short = vp_short.rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).sum()
    sma_short = df_copy["close"].rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).mean()
    div_short = (vwap_short - sma_short) / sma_short.replace(0, np.nan)
    # Base-window VWAP-SMA divergence
    vp_base = df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]
    vwap_base = vp_base.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).sum()
    sma_base = df_copy["close"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    div_base = (vwap_base - sma_base) / sma_base.replace(0, np.nan)
    # Smooth blend using sigmoid of compression score
    blend = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-compression))
    factor = blend * div_short + (1.0 - blend) * div_base
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_smooth_blend"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_smooth_blend"]
description: Smooths the parent's binary compression gate into a continuous blend of short and base window VWAP-SMA divergences, aiming to improve IC by reducing regime-switching noise while preserving the regime-adaptive RankIC stability.
